text_block_list.text: It happened on a certain day toward the latter half of October—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we need to talk.
...About our plans going forward.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Pardon me for being sudden, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Could we at least hold off on entering races for the rest of this month and focus on training?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Not only Daiichi Ruby, but that bottomless storm... Daitaku Helios will also be running in the next Mile CS.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Right now, I wish to focus and prepare for that crucial race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My "promise" with Teio-san for next year... To conquer three divisions and surpass the "Emperor of the Mile."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wish to polish my own wind even further.
...For now.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I am grateful for your benevolent judgment.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well then... shall we get started today as well?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Fiercer! Even fiercer!
Into a true... gale storm!!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Incredible. I could feel it all the way over here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr, you're... steadily becoming
a true wind itself, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: The wind...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to be like that again, too—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It's still just a gentle breeze.
Keep it coming, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's keep this momentum going!

text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr's enthusiasm for training is burning bright. Just as we discussed, let's hold off on entering races for now.
